source.title: Ministry of Home Affairs (Government of India), Emergency Response Support System (ERSS) page
source.fact_used: 112 is India's single emergency number (ERSS: 'One India One Emergency Number 112').
source.reuse_note: MHA's website policy does not allow reproducing its content without permission, so no MHA text is bundled. Only the number and a one-line fact in AuraHealth's own words are used, with this reference.

guidance_note: No India-specific guidance cards are bundled. The general first-aid guides come from the IFRC 2020 guidelines (packs/guides), adapted in plain English and not yet reviewed by a clinician.

source.title: Tele-MANAS, the National Tele Mental Health Programme, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
source.fact_used: Free national mental-health helpline on 14416, with a choice of language.
source.check_note: Confirmed from web search results of government and news pages. The official pages did not load as text, so a person must confirm the number by calling it before any pilot.

capabilities.note: What AuraHealth actually offers for this country. Language is separate from country: choosing Telugu does not change the medical rules.
capabilities.age_scope: Adults and family caregivers. Children, pregnancy and older adults get general information and a push to get care, with no individual dosing.
